# Queen Mary (ship)

The following ships are named Queen Mary:
* , a battlecruiser of the Royal Navy entered service in 1913 and sank at the Battle of Jutland in 1916
* , a Clyde steamer in service 1933–1977, now retired and  under restoration on the River Clyde in Scotland, United Kingdom
* , a Cunard Line ocean liner in service 1936–1967, now retired and used as a hotel in Long Beach, California, United States
* , a Cunard Line ocean liner that entered service in 2004.
